text: Private foundations exercise plutocratic power because their leaders and trustees are not elected democratically, they are permitted to operate in perpetuity, and their operations lack accountability and transparency.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021

abstract: Private foundations have plutocratic power because such organizations' leaders or trustees are not elected democratically, they are allowed to work in perpetuity, and their operations lack accountability and transparency.
